title: K-17 tracer PET-CT: fictional coverage policy
notice: This policy is fictional. It is not a real payer's policy, not medical advice, and all data is synthetic. The disease is fictional.

criteria.text: At least 2 of Velorin index, Tarnic acid and Dorrin ratio are above their reference range.
Tremor is present and at least one other symptom is present.
Symptoms have lasted 6 weeks or more.
No PET-CT or comparable imaging in the last 12 months.
A specialist evaluation has taken place.
